content.comment_body: Hello, I've managed to show the floating value on the device display using the F/L module and eAQ, which enables very large numbers to be visualized. However, when I try to present the same eAQ value on the web interface, the tool only lets me display a single word instead of both. Is there a method to fully convert and present the complete value online? Maybe modifying the generated HTML5 code by the editor could help? Thank you.

Are you asking specifically about showing the voltage level? Do you need all four decimal places? Would one or two decimal places be acceptable? If so, you could restrict the value in the F/I converter to two decimal places and simply display the standard Aq value on the web interface.

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue is a gap between how the device and web interface show large floating point eAQ values. This limitation stems from only part of the data being sent to the web server, leading to less accurate visualization online compared to the device’s own display.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to reliably present the entire, accurate eAQ value on the web server exactly as it appears on the device display, preserving both format and precision.
